description: This file manages stale gateway processes by inspecting TCP ports, parsing process IDs via lsof, and terminating processes to prevent port conflicts during system restarts. It includes functions for polling port status, killing processes, and testing overrides.

methods.name: findGatewayPidsOnPortSync
methods.description: Finds PIDs of openclaw gateway processes listening on a specific port using synchronous lsof.

methods.name: parsePidsFromLsofOutput
methods.description: Parses stdout from lsof to extract process IDs of openclaw gateway processes.

methods.name: pollPortOnce
methods.description: Performs a single check to determine if a port is free, busy, or if lsof is unavailable.

methods.name: waitForPortFreeSync
methods.description: Polls a port until it is confirmed free or the timeout expires.

methods.name: terminateStaleProcessesSync
methods.description: Terminates a list of process IDs by sending SIGTERM and SIGKILL.

methods.name: cleanStaleGatewayProcessesSync
methods.description: Main function to inspect and kill stale gateway processes holding a port, then waits for port release.
